focus: Dallas (Uptown, Oak Lawn, Lakewood, East Dallas, Park Cities area, North and Far North Dallas, Downtown, and Oak Cliff)
intro: This first Dallas page covers private mailbox stores inside the city of Dallas whose own public pages list an address, staffed hours, and package acceptance — independent pack-and-ship stores in Uptown, Lakewood, Lake Highlands, East Dallas, the Park Cities area, and Far North Dallas, plus ten UPS Store locations from Oak Cliff to Far North Dallas. It is not a complete metro inventory; Fort Worth and the suburbs are not covered yet. 24-hour lobby access is flagged only when the store’s own page says so. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for those stores. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental page says the store accepts packages and mail from the Post Office, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and couriers.

listings.area: Dallas · Lakewood (Mockingbird and Abrams, Tom Thumb Shopping Center)
listings.address: 6333 E Mockingbird Lane, Suite 147, Dallas, TX 75214

hours.notes: Staffed hours from the Eagle Postal Centers mailboxes page (M–F and Saturday listed). Sunday hours are not published.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailboxes page says renters can receive mail and packages from any courier, including Amazon, DHL, FedEx, UPS, and USPS.
listings.visitNotes: The company’s mailboxes page says traditional mailbox rentals include secure 24/7 access with a private door code; that statement covers its three Dallas stores rather than naming this one. It also offers virtual mailboxes that scan mail and packages as they arrive. Box availability is not published as live inventory; confirm with the store.

listings.name: Park Cities Postal
listings.area: Dallas · Snider Plaza / Hillcrest Ave (Park Cities)
listings.address: 6601 Hillcrest Ave, Suite E, Dallas, TX 75205

hours.notes: Store hours from the rent-a-mailbox page: Monday–Friday 10 AM–6 PM; Saturday 12 PM–3 PM. Sunday hours are not published.

listings.carriersNotes: The rent-a-mailbox page says FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL, and Amazon all deliver to its boxes.
listings.visitNotes: The page says “Available now — limited boxes open.” Treat that as a claim to confirm, not live inventory. 24-hour access is not mentioned. The page says you can activate a box in store with two IDs, and a notary is on site by appointment. No phone number was shown on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-19: small box from $22/month, or $18/month billed annually; one-time $25 setup and $10 key deposit.
